messages:
incident-bot: Paging: high request queue depth observed on group inference pools in us-west-2. error-rate increased ~8% and p95 latency spiking. Pager: @maya oncall. Please ack.
maya: Acked. pulling up dashboards now. p95 looks like 1.8s -> 3.7s for text-generation, queue depth 4x.
maya: quick check: is this sustained or a short burst?
zack: seeing a sustained surge for the last 8m from a handful of API keys, but also general baseline rising. looks correlated with continuous-batcher backlog growth.
priya: adding context: one high-volume customer started a large embedding job ~10m ago, and a small spike of long-seq generation jobs is also present.
maya: ok. we need live mitigations: propose 1) apply per-key rate caps for the top offending keys, 2) expand batch window to 100ms (current 20ms) to accept higher latency but increase throughput, 3) temporarily disable async-embeddings for free-tier.
carol: +1 for per-key caps. How do we apply batch window change w/o rollout risk?
zack: we can set config override on the serving pool via /api/v1/admin/configs patch. I have the curl ready.
zack: ```bash
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/pools/us-west-2/config -d '{"continuous_batching":{"max_batch_wait_ms":100,"max_batch_size":256}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```
priya: note: increasing max_batch_wait_ms to 100ms will raise p95 by ~60-80ms ideally, but it should reduce queue drain time and drop request rejects. tradeoff accepted for now.
maya: prepping per-key caps. zack, can you surface the top 5 keys?
zack: pulling list... top5_keys = [key_akl45, key_hq9z2, key_pwr88, key_demo, key_intern]. key_akl45 responsible for ~40% of surge.
zack: I'll apply a 20rps cap for key_akl45 and 10rps for the next two. command: ```python
# admin sdk snippet
client.apply_quota(key='key_akl45', rps=20, window=60)
```
carol: I'll push the embedding disable toggle for free-tier now. it's feature flag: ff/embeddings-free-tier -> false.
carol: ```bash
kfctl exec ff-service -- patch /flags/embeddings-free-tier -p '{"enabled":false}'
```
incident-bot: Note: customer-impact tag added to thread.
maya: making TL;DR to oncoming: changed continuous_batching.max_batch_wait_ms 20->100, max_batch_size 128->256, applied per-key rate caps for top noisy keys, disabled free-tier embeddings. Metrics will update in 30s. handing off to @priya for monitoring 30m.
priya: taking over. I'll watch queues and p95, and rollback or tune if errors increase. please DM if anything urgent.
zack: initial effect: queue depth dropping 35% after 40s, generator rejects down from 6% -> 1.2%. p95 trending down to ~2.1s.
priya: good. leaving a note for follow-up: we should schedule a postmortem to consider better per-tenant shaping & preemptive throttles, and add a safe-mode runbook for batch-window increases.
maya: agreed. I'll create an incident ticket and assign postmortem owners. thanks team. :thumbsup:
